Hello everyone, just a little background about myself 29m, living in uk from eastern Europe. I did coke and mdma from 23-27, ( every weekend coke + alcohol both in large quantities) i’ve been sober since September 2024( i made it cold turkey, was tough asf but made it, i stopped smoking cigarettes as well) (but i a am in debt 9k gbp)

The only thing that i changed and was consistent was running regularly and reading. Gym was on and off but recently (2months) i’ve been consistent.

I did accutane for my acnee, fixed it but gave me more raging moments and i stopped…🤦‍♂️

The main issues: I still struggle with a form of addiction( escorts, sometimes porn) and the terrible limerence of someone( i realised that i am not the person to have someone in his life right now and not even that LO) but i can’t stop comparing and thinking about her.. (been 2-3 years by now)

I’m stuck studying Business Management atm but I finish next year.

My question’s are I think….

How can i regain my brain, i tried sertraline 50/100mg, did not work. Terrible brain fog and tiredness. Can’t watch a tv series or a movie because my mind is everywhere.

I feel like I’m 18, like I stopped to grow up and it gets me mad and sad. Like i am a functional retard.( i don’t want to sound like i’m complaining, is just the way i feel)

I have problems rembering things that i just read, places, or i’m losing the narrative of a conversation and i have to ask again details…
Everything i do i rush like i try to recover the lost time.

How can i forget her, i’m just tired…

And i don’t know what to do in the future, i could do a second degree to do Computer Science but this sector is shaky and i am the way i am and i don’t know if i could invest another 4 years…

Thank you for everyone who spent time to read about my situation…
